up-uhc: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
UHC tools (downloaded)        by the author (Patrik, UHC)      https://uhc.megaburken.net/uhcinstall
install scripts               UP-Term's licence                this package

Notes
- This package contains no UHC file. Install downloads the author's installer uhcinstall from his server and runs
  it as it is; that installer downloads uhctools_os3.lha (mirrors: uhc.driar.se, uhc.a1k.org, uhc.no0b.de,
  uhc.hex9d.com) and unpacks it. No UHC file is replaced or changed.
